---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or an improvement to an existing one
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Motivation

What problem does this solve? Who benefits and how? (One or two
sentences on the user or operator experience is usually enough.)

## Proposal

What do you want dcloud to do? Include any concrete UI, API, or config
shape you have in mind.

## Alternatives considered

Have you tried anything already, or are there existing knobs that come
close? Why aren't they enough?

## Scope

- [ ] Does this affect the wire format (proto)? If yes, be explicit
      about backwards compatibility.
- [ ] Does this change the Helm chart's default behaviour?
- [ ] Does it introduce a new external dependency (upstream project)?

## Additional context

Links to related issues, upstream discussions, prior art, or design
docs.
